subject: COLA status: probe numbers + pipeline risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: SSL pre-training on LibriSpeech (LBS) reproduced cleanly, checkpoints landing under the standard model_dir layout. Downstream: a linear probe on Speech Commands v2 (SPCV2) with freeze_encoder=true gets 93.8%, and full fine-tuning reaches 95.4% — so frozen embeddings sit ~1.6 points off task-specific, inside Dmitri's 2-point success bar.

The trade-off to discuss: frozen-encoder serving is cheap and one-model-for-everything, but two downstream teams (wake-word and audio events) asked about fine-tuned variants, which multiplies serving cost and breaks the single-backbone story.

Risk: our input pipelines are TFDS-based; re-pointing them at Corpus-registered datasets is where Halima is spending most of her time, and it's slower than planned. She thinks two more weeks.

Vera
